name: omp-copilot-credits
description: Show remaining GitHub Copilot AI credits, burn rate, and runway in the oh-my-pi status line
author: Jonah Slack

showHourly.description: Show credits spent in the last hour across all agents (420/h)

showDaily.description: Show average credits per day since the last reset (561/d)

showRunway.description: Show estimated days until credits run out (~201d)

showReset.description: Show the next reset date (↻ Oct 1)

visibility.description: copilot: only while a GitHub Copilot model is active · always: whenever quota data exists

bucket.description: Which Copilot quota to track; auto picks premium interactions, else chat
